blocks.explanation:
Upar bhi teen brackets aur neeche bhi teen, yani dono cubic (degree 3): improper fraction.
Pehle quotient 1 nikalega, phir bacha hua hissa teen mukhtalif linear factors par Case I se tootega.
Plan: dono ko khol kar divide, identity, \(x = 2, 4, 6\) rakhna, coefficients compare, aur jor kar tasdeeq.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\frac{(x - 1)(x - 3)(x - 5)}{(x - 2)(x - 4)(x - 6)}\)
Maloom karna hai: is ke partial fractions.
Tareeqa: Degrees barabar hain, is liye pehle divide. Dono ke leading coefficients 1 hain, to quotient 1 hoga. Phir proper remainder ke liye Case I.

Upar aur neeche ko khol kar likhein
\[(x - 1)(x - 3)(x - 5)\]
\[= x^3 - 9x^2 + 23x - 15\]
\[(x - 2)(x - 4)(x - 6)\]
\[= x^3 - 12x^2 + 44x - 48\]
Kyun: Remainder nikalne ke liye humein upar mein se neeche ko minus karna hai, aur yeh tab hi ho sakta hai jab dono polynomials khule hon. Pehle do brackets multiply karein, phir teesra.

Divide karein
\[\text{remainder} = (x^3 - 9x^2 + 23x - 15)\]
\[- (x^3 - 12x^2 + 44x - 48)\]
\[= 3x^2 - 21x + 33\]
\[\text{fraction} = 1 + \dfrac{3x^2 - 21x + 33}{(x - 2)(x - 4)(x - 6)}\]
Kyun: \(x^3 \div x^3 = 1\), aur neeche wala ek dafa minus karne se degree 2 ka remainder bachta hai.
Dhyan dein: \(-9 - (-12) = 3\), \(23 - 44 = -21\), \(-15 - (-48) = 33\); bracket ke saare signs badalna na bhoolein.

Shakal aur identity likhein
\[\dfrac{3x^2 - 21x + 33}{(x - 2)(x - 4)(x - 6)}\]
\[= \dfrac{A}{x - 2} + \dfrac{B}{x - 4} + \dfrac{C}{x - 6}\]
\[3x^2 - 21x + 33 = A(x - 4)(x - 6)\]
\[+ B(x - 2)(x - 6) + C(x - 2)(x - 4) \quad (i)\]
Kyun: Teen mukhtalif linear factors; poore denominator se multiply kar ke fractions hata diye.

\(A\) nikalein: (i) mein \(x = 2\) rakhein
\[12 - 42 + 33 = A(-2)(-4)\]
\[3 = 8A\]
\[A = \tfrac{3}{8}\]
Kyun: \(x - 2 = 0\), sirf \(A\) bachta hai. Baayen taraf \(3(4) - 21(2) + 33 = 3\).

\(B\) nikalein: (i) mein \(x = 4\) rakhein
\[48 - 84 + 33 = B(2)(-2)\]
\[-3 = -4B\]
\[B = \tfrac{3}{4}\]
Kyun: \(x - 4 = 0\), sirf \(B\) bachta hai. Do minus wale numbers ki taqseem musbat hoti hai.

Coefficients compare karein
\[x^2:\ A + B + C = \tfrac{3}{8} + \tfrac{6}{8} + \tfrac{15}{8} = 3 \;\checkmark\]
\[\text{const}:\ 24A + 12B + 8C\]
\[= 9 + 9 + 15 = 33 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: (i) mein constants brackets ke aakhri numbers ke zarb se aate hain: \((-4)(-6) = 24\), \((-2)(-6) = 12\), \((-2)(-4) = 8\). Dono baraabariyan poori hui, is liye teenon constants pakke hain.

Jawab likhein
\[= 1 + \dfrac{3}{8(x - 2)} + \dfrac{3}{4(x - 4)} + \dfrac{15}{8(x - 6)}\]
Kyun: Quotient 1 aur teen partial fractions. Quotient 1 likhna mat bhooliye; is ke baghair jawab asal fraction ke barabar nahi rehta.

Tasdeeq: fractions wapas jor kar dekhein
\(8(x - 2)(x - 4)(x - 6)\) par numerator:
\[3(x^2 - 10x + 24) + 6(x^2 - 8x + 12)\]
\[+ 15(x^2 - 6x + 8)\]
\[= 24x^2 - 168x + 264\]
\[= 8(3x^2 - 21x + 33) \;\checkmark\]
1 wapas jorein: neeche + remainder \(= x^3 - 9x^2 + 23x - 15\), yani asal numerator \(\checkmark\)
Kyun: Fractions jor kar remainder mila, aur quotient guna denominator jama remainder se asal upar wala hissa wapas aa gaya.
